checks.summary: The documented one-command development path cannot give the sandboxed plugin the companion's private per-run bearer token without persisting, exposing, or serving it.
checks.reason: The bridge requires an ephemeral bearer token, but the frozen plugin scope defines no compliant runtime handoff from the owner-only filesystem record to Figma.

checks.summary: Frame export and compact UI are feasible, but authenticated capabilities cannot load from the current companion under the frozen no-persistence and no-bridge-change constraints.
checks.reason: Neither the Figma main sandbox nor its iframe can read `.local/dresser-figma/runtime.json`, and the bridge does not expose the token.

checks.summary: The frozen dresser-preset/v1 capability schema is closed, bounded, and sufficient to populate every required PNG-relevant control without inventing settings.
The approved contract makes browser PNG bytes the only preview source and defines explicit initial, stale, update, and pre-insert rendering transitions.
The packet specifies a single new image-filled rectangle, exact name and absolute placement, selected result, and unchanged source/unrelated nodes.
Selection, message, companion, response, image, duplicate, and insertion failures are enumerated with recoverable no-partial-mutation outcomes.
Both source export and returned PNG are bounded by explicit proportional downscale, PNG dimension validation, and Figma's documented 4096 px image limit.
The approved visual contract freezes compact and expanded layouts, light/dark theming, focus, labels, states, reduced motion, icon fallback, and accessibility review.
The intended data boundary is explicit and testable, but it is also the constraint that makes the undefined bearer-token handoff blocking under acceptance 1 and 2.
The task owns the plugin tests and package script needed to add this bounded command during implementation.
The task owns all plugin source and the scoped package script needed for a no-warning lint gate.
The task owns the sandbox-safe main/UI build, local manifest generation, and package script needed for the frozen build gate.
The existing MCP regression command is real and protects the renderer that remains outside plugin scope.
The manifest, real development ID, CSP/network, built artifact, console, and themed launch checks are concrete; authenticated startup remains separately failed by acceptance 1 and 2.
The observable demo freezes one disposable top-level Frame, exact preview/settings flow, source/result metadata, 80 px placement, and source preservation.
The check covers live option reconciliation and representative model/background/ratio/position pixel comparisons without unsupported controls.
The negative matrix includes selection drift, malformed/stale messages, missing identity, bridge failures, invalid results, duplicate insert, and restart with no partial node.
The check directly exercises below/above-limit and extreme-ratio frames, matching dimensions, predictable placement, one undo step, and no source mutation.
The task freezes a typed named-import resolver, Question fallback, development-only diagnostic, and bans placeholder/full-catalog alternatives.
The visual/accessibility check covers both approved sizes and themes, keyboard order, focus, labels, announcements, names, geometry, disabled/loading states, and clipping.
The final check is correctly scoped to loopback PNG/preset traffic, sensitive-data absence, no persistence, scoped diff, and neighbor preservation.
Plugin ownership is explicit and isolated from the verified bridge, mirror, MCP, portfolio, generated dist, publication, deployment, remote delivery, and unrelated dirty work.
The approved compact visual contract and explicit Mobbin waiver freeze hierarchy, states, defaults, responsiveness, icons, and accessibility without new UX discretion.
Figma and companion boundaries are enumerated with real manifest/import, network, negative, render, cleanup, and regression evidence requirements.
The packet simultaneously requires authenticated companion access, forbids token persistence/exposure, and excludes the only component that could add a runtime bootstrap channel.
checks.reason: Any currently available token handoff either persists/exposes the secret or changes the out-of-scope bridge contract.

findings.summary: No compliant bearer-token handoff exists from the local companion runtime record to the sandboxed Figma plugin.
